scope: Feature-gated existing-slot engineering example and bounded typed TSV consumer; no engine implementation, dependency, normal CLI or save-scope change.
source_scope: Consumer files were uncommitted during these checks; core API bytes match the committed feature. Final committed consumer artifact/replay is separate. The core record remains historical after this consumer adds its owning guide link.

preserved_failure.command: cargo test --locked --offline -j2 -p tablecraft-ace --features ace16-write-preview --example preview_ace16_slot malformed_kinds_fields_rows_hex_and_utf8
preserved_failure.reason: The prototype used u8::from_str_radix and accepted +1 as a byte. A new literal malformed-hex control exposed the mismatch with ASCII hex-pair grammar. Replaced only consumer decoding with explicit ASCII nibble admission; no engine/golden widening.

acceptance: Exact positional SOURCE OUTPUT TABLE COLUMN TSV, without normal CLI/write switches.
Headerless five-field quoted TSV: literal UTF8 Text including NUL; exact ASCII hex Binary; NULL requires empty data; all empty carriers remain distinct.
All file capture/parsing precedes database and output opens; malformed later assignment returns no batch or candidate.
16MiB capture, 4096 requests, 1024 encoded bytes per data field, subject to one shared 256MiB/100kRows/100MSteps allowance.
Three prepaid record buffers total (two header caches and the reused explicitly sized ByteRecord); hostile field counts, count/width limits and typed Bytes/Rows/Steps exhaustion covered.
Real API filesystem candidate reopens with the ordinary reader/checker; fresh output only, existing output and original source preserved.
Injected partial-write failure removes only newly owned output; existing path prevents the callback and preserves its bytes.
boundaries: Native Access comparison, macro qualification, normal backend saves, arbitrary width growth and journalability remain outside this engineering consumer.
The new parser uses csv existing quoted-TSV behavior rather than claiming an additional strict CSV grammar.
Input ceilings do not promise every below-ceiling file fits cumulative parser/image/check budgets.
No original database or accepted fixture/helper was modified or regenerated.
No new dependency or lockfile change.
